prompt: An invoice has 17 items costing 1299 cents each and 8 items costing 2375 cents each. Subtract a 1875-cent coupon. Add exactly 8% tax to the discounted subtotal, rounding half up to the nearest cent. Reply with the final integer number of cents only.

Convert this record into one JSON object only, with keys "name", "active", "tags", "count", "note". Name: Ada "Byte" Lovelace. Active: yes. Tags, in order: gpu, fp4. Count: zero. Note: missing (use JSON null). Do not add keys or Markdown.

Write Python function merge_intervals(intervals). Each input is a list of two integers [start,end], with start<=end. Return new lists for the union of closed intervals, sorted by start; intervals sharing an endpoint merge. Do not mutate the input. Handle empty input. Return only the function, optionally in a Python code fence. No imports, decorators, helpers, annotations or I/O; use ordinary Python built-ins.

Write Python function rle(text) returning a list of [character,count] lists for consecutive runs. Example: 'aaabbcaa' -> [['a',3],['b',2],['c',1],['a',2]]. Empty input gives []. Treat Unicode characters normally and preserve case. Return only the function, optionally in a Python code fence. No imports, decorators, helpers, annotations or I/O; use ordinary Python built-ins.
